DDA launches digital system to track sapling survival in Delhi

The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) has launched a new digital monitoring system to track the survival rates of saplings planted across the city. This system utilizes geo-tagging to monitor the planted saplings. The initiative aims to improve the survival rate of these saplings. The system was rolled out by the DDA.
